npcs.name: Keeper of Paths
npcs.role: Ancient storyteller in the void — guides the adventurer's journey
npcs.note: A keeper of lost and forgotten things. Offered to seal the talisman in a blood-keyed iron lockbox — only the player's hand can open it — but warned the Hollow Forge reads relics to learn their truth, and without it the forge would have to read the player instead, a far more…
npcs.desc: A flicker of amber light where eyes might be; voice like stone grinding over stone. Self-described weaver of fates who asks the adventurer four questions about mood, goals, pact, and past before beginning.
npcs.met_at: The player declined to leave the obsidian talisman with the Keeper of Paths, choosing to keep it and travel up to the Upper Rings toward the Hollow Forge via the iron lung, while the messenger drone urges them to hurry to the lift. — Day 1

npcs.name: Kip
npcs.note: Swore a courier pact at Hollow Forge to carry messages and watch the player's back. Running passive scans, no Solke trackers found.
npcs.desc: Warns the player that the door seems to react to them; appears cautious but curious.
npcs.met_at: Kip scouted both routes and confirmed no Solke trackers. Party took a short rest. — Day 6

npcs.name: Messenger Drone
npcs.note: Cuffed and captured at the player's feet. Emitted a weak, garbled transmission about Merith's lost signal before falling to static. Now serves as a potential informant.
npcs.desc: Nervous, youthful voice; warns of danger; invites to the Lower Rings.
npcs.met_at: The player successfully persuades the Messenger Drone to reveal that four heavily armored enforcers are descending toward their position. Kaelen and Kip prepare a makeshift trap at the junction while the player weighs whether to descend into the amber-lit shaft or hold position. — Day 4

npcs.name: Ash Walker
npcs.desc: Calls you 'The Obsidian Ember' and claims to know the talisman's true nature. Says they mean no harm.
npcs.met_at: Vespera is stabilized by the fused obsidian talisman and fully healed, while her allies Kaelen Voss and Ash Walker defeat the remaining Security Drone and Solke Guards to end the ambush. — Day 6

npcs.name: Kaelen Voss
npcs.role: Relic hunter from the outer rings
npcs.desc: Relic hunter who has been chasing whispers of the Ash Witches for years. Claims to know the Upper Rings: the lifts, tolls, and foremen who don't ask questions. Travel-worn, armed with a blade, has dried blood on his cloak. Extends a hand in friendship but awaits the player's acceptance.
npcs.met_at: Vespera is stabilized by the fused obsidian talisman and fully healed, while her allies Kaelen Voss and Ash Walker defeat the remaining Security Drone and Solke Guards to end the ambush. — Day 6

npcs.name: Vespera
npcs.note: Mirror-Vespera is a construct or projection, not the real Vespera. She is bound to the Mirror Chamber and serves as a guide/keeper of knowledge about the Cradle. She knows the history of all previous Vessels who attempted the Cradle's trial. Her scarred hand and hollow eyes…
npcs.desc: Identitet avslöjad: Kaelen cried out 'Vespera—' as the ash-robed woman stepped through the crucible fire and appeared physically before the player.
npcs.met_at: Vespera is stabilized by the fused obsidian talisman and fully healed, while her allies Kaelen Voss and Ash Walker defeat the remaining Security Drone and Solke Guards to end the ambush. — Day 6

npcs.name: Merith Solke
npcs.note: Controls the access shaft above the Cradle. Has 4 surveillance units and 2 shock troopers on rotating shifts. One drone disabled by the party — 3 remain. Likely stationed in her office in the Upper Rings behind glass walls. Holds the western sigil fragment needed to activate the…
npcs.desc: Tall, lean, dark leather coat with brass buttons shaped like closed eyes. Shaved head on one side, black hair falling past jaw on the other. Thin scar from temple to corner of mouth creating a permanent half-smirk. Speaks with a smoky, gravelly voice. Self-described trader in 'questions and…
npcs.met_at: Kip briefed the party on Merith Solke's forces: she holds the western sigil fragment in her Upper Rings office, guarded by three remaining drones and two shock troopers, and will likely move the fragment if she learns they are heading for the Cradle. — Day 6

npcs.name: Clerk
npcs.met_at: The player slipped on the ash-slick obsidian ledge, falling 15 feet onto Veyl's Lantern Court's lowest tier and taking 3 bludgeoning damage. The impact caused the obsidian talisman to pulse brightly, alerting two court clerks below. — Day 4

npcs.name: Surveillance Drone

npcs.desc: Subdued and captured with manacles; ready for interrogation. No longer hostile.
npcs.met_at: Kip accessed the captured surveillance drone's memory core, retrieving critical intel on Merith's forces, an unguarded maintenance tunnel to the Hollow Forge, and a bounty placed on Vespera. — Day 4

npcs.name: Ashen Ledger Scribe
npcs.role: Record keeper of the Ashen Ledger
npcs.note: Keeper of the Ashen Ledger's ancient records, knowledgeable about the Unbound Flame, the bloodline seal, and the Solke betrayal.
npcs.desc: Face obscured by an ash veil, speaks with a voice like turning parchment. Manages the Ashen Ledger's records, expects the party, and refuses to deal in tricks or half-truths. Addresses Vespera as the Vessel of the Unbound Flame.
npcs.met_at: The Ashen Ledger scribe revealed the player's bloodline oath to contain the Unbound Flame, the stolen sigil fragment in Merith Solke's office, and the full moon deadline for seal renewal. The player requested access to Vessel Cradle records to find a way to renew the sigil without sacrificing their… — Day 4

npcs.name: Scribe
npcs.role: Keeper of records in the Ashen Ledger
npcs.note: Ancient record-keeper with ash veil, voice like turning parchment. Knows the player's true name and refers to the obsidian talisman as the Unbound Flame.
npcs.desc: Ancient record-keeper with ash veil, voice like turning parchment. Knows the player's true name and refers to the obsidian talisman as the Unbound Flame.
npcs.met_at: The party stands in the Mirror Chamber, facing the sealed mirror inscribed with the ash-grey words. Kip examines the inscription while the brass keycard and obsidian talisman react to proximity. Kaelen was blocked by a stone flare from following through. — Day 6

npcs.name: Ashen Scribe
npcs.note: According to Kip, the Ashen Scribe claimed that every fire signs a debt, and that the Unbound Flame burns because it was promised fuel and never received it.
npcs.desc: Holds ancient knowledge of the Vessel Cradle, the location of the western sigil fragment in Merith Solke's office, and the impending seal collapse in three days.

npcs.name: Mirror-Vespera
npcs.role: Mirror reflection of Vespera within the Mirror Chamber
npcs.note: Revealed her true nature: she is not the player's soul split in half, but 'a copy of a memory that never happened.' Created by the Ash Witches during the first contract — they reached forward through the Cradle and took a memory from a Vessel who did not yet exist (the player)…
npcs.desc: This reflection or echo watches the blood offering and appears connected to the obsidian basin's contract magic.
npcs.met_at: The player left Mirror-Vespera and wiped pact-fire residue from the obsidian walls to conceal their presence from approaching drones. — Day 6

npcs.name: Guard
npcs.met_at: Vespera is stabilized by the fused obsidian talisman and fully healed, while her allies Kaelen Voss and Ash Walker defeat the remaining Security Drone and Solke Guards to end the ambush. — Day 6

npcs.name: Kaelithra the Unbroken
npcs.note: Dressed in skimpy leather, tight rope shibari corset, steel collar etched with the player's patron sigil, and leather muzzle; fully submissive, her violet sigil flares in sync with the player's.
npcs.desc: Half clockwork (brass/iron mechanical left half with steam-emitting joints) and half scarred human, wields a serrated steam-powered glaive. Sold Xylith to the Thirsting Coin for three border villages, intends to break Xylith before sacrificing their soul to the god that banished them.
npcs.met_at: The player meets Elowen the Unblemished at the agreed meeting point, attempting to gain her trust while Kaelithra the Unbroken lurks unseen nearby, ready to ambush on signal. — Day 1
